title: Age-depth control points from IODP Site 397-U1385
citation: Hodell, D. A. et al. (2026), Supplementary material. DOI: 10.14379/iodp.proc.397.204supp.2026
processing: Extract two adjacent published age-depth control points. Calculate thickness, duration, average accumulation rate and the nominal time represented by 1 cm. No age tuning, interpolation of ages or proxy-to-temperature conversion is performed.
scope: CCSF is the composite depth coordinate, not the original borehole depth. Ages are published estimates assigned on the LR04 chronology. The interval lies below the piston-cored upper part. 1 cm / rate describes nominal spacing, not effective temporal resolution.
source_note: The workbook Citation sheet retains a 2025 draft citation. The definitive publication and supplement DOI are dated 2026. Use the linked definitive record.
